scope: Local Docker Desktop Linux ARM64 worker on macOS ARM64; deterministic fixtures only. This is not an AWS EC2 production-host or live-model-provider measurement.

limits.mounts: No host or runtime volume mounts; temporary profile uses bounded tmpfs

assertions: Real PNG renders the shared prepared document
Dark mobile and light desktop appearances render
Remote HTTPS, link-local metadata and file URL fetches are denied
Console output stops at 20 entries and 500 characters per entry
Owned container is force-removed on deadline
Active cancellation kills the owned job
No preview containers remain after completion

queue.fixture: Each page runs a two-second CPU loop before capture

resourceSample.method: docker stats --no-stream during the first admitted job
resourceSample.note: One sample, not peak memory or a production throughput result

assertions: Exactly one running job and four waiting jobs are admitted
Queue drains and containers are removed
Authenticated supervisor returns a real Chromium PNG
Caller abort disconnects HTTP and cancels the Docker job
A following admitted job fences asynchronous cleanup
privateHttpDeploymentPath.transport: Loopback HTTP fixture; production requires authenticated TLS/private networking

supervisorLoss.fixture: Font-ready settlement never resolves; supervising Docker client receives SIGKILL
assertions: Independent worker watchdog exits without a live supervisor
Only the captured, uniquely named fixture job is affected

browserSandboxProbe.unprivilegedNamespaceProbe: unshare --user true fails: Operation not permitted under the same container restrictions
browserSandboxProbe.boundary: Explicit Chromium sandbox opt-out inside the isolated container only; no unsandboxed host execution mode

remainingValidation: Production renderer host, TLS/private-network routing and Docker permissions
Live provider acceptance and visual interpretation of screenshot messages
Sustained production load, rather than five fixture jobs and one resource sample
